description: Most clues concentrated in one location with few in others
detective_experience: Feels like crime scene focus, detailed investigation of one area
distribution_pattern: 1-2 dense rooms (3-4 clues each), rest empty or sparse
best_for: scenes where killer made a critical mistake in one place, obvious locus of activity

description: One clue per room leading detective through entire location
detective_experience: Feels like progressive revelation, discovering motive layer by layer
distribution_pattern: 5 clues in 5 different rooms, minimal duplication
best_for: stories where killer left a trail of evidence across the property, telling a story through location

description: Crucial clues in common areas with minimal protection, overlooked because of ordinariness
detective_experience: Feels like detective must look twice, realize significance of ordinary objects
distribution_pattern: Clues spread across 3-4 common rooms, indistinguishable from normal items
best_for: clever crimes where killer relies on psychological bias against noticing familiar things

description: Clues become more specific and valuable as detective searches, rewarding thorough investigation
detective_experience: Feels like genuine detective work: surface clues lead to deeper understanding
distribution_pattern: Generic clues in many places, specific clues only in thoroughly searched locations
best_for: methodical mysteries where persistence pays off, encouraging exhaustive search

description: Motive clues in private areas, method clues in common areas, alibi-breaking clues elsewhere
detective_experience: Feels like detective must synthesize information from different regions
distribution_pattern: Clue types segregated by location: bedroom area, common area, service area
best_for: complex crimes requiring detective to connect disparate locations into coherent narrative

description: Clues positioned to reveal events in chronological order when found systematically
detective_experience: Feels like detective is reconstructing the sequence of the crime
distribution_pattern: Clues arranged to tell timeline story through discovery order, not location
best_for: crimes where sequence of events is crucial, detective must understand 'when' not just 'what'

description: Each suspect has implicated clues in proximity to where they were seen
detective_experience: Feels like natural suspicion emerging from proximity, but some clues are false leads
distribution_pattern: Clues distributed near each suspect's known location, red herrings mixed in
best_for: mysteries where physical evidence seems to point to wrong suspect initially

description: Public areas have innocuous clues, private areas reveal true secrets and motives
detective_experience: Feels like invasion of privacy reveals truth, contrast between person's public and private self
distribution_pattern: Shallow clues in public rooms, deep secrets in bedrooms/studies/private spaces
best_for: character-driven mysteries where true self is hidden beneath social facade
